scripts.build: node scripts/docs.mjs build-local && vp run build:release
scripts.build:release: vp run cache:build && node scripts/docs.mjs assemble .docs
scripts.deploy: vp run build && vp exec convex deploy --yes && vp exec static-hosting upload --dist ./dist/client --component staticHosting --prod
scripts.deploy:release: vp run build:release && vp exec convex deploy --yes && vp exec static-hosting upload --dist ./dist/client --component staticHosting --prod
scripts.deploy:dev: vp exec convex dev --once && vp run build && vp exec static-hosting upload --dist ./dist/client --component staticHosting
